protocol: V88 independent external real-traffic attack/benign freeze
claim_boundary: Independent external captured-IoT-traffic evaluation. No IoT-23 sample, label, scaler statistic, decision threshold, hyperparameter, feature-selection decision, or model-selection metric may be used for fitting or tuning. This is controlled/lab IoT traffic with real malware and real IoT devices, not production-enterprise traffic.

precommit.malicious_reason: Single manageable 24-hour Mirai capture with official raw PCAP provenance and expert-labeled Zeek flows, fixed before scoring.
precommit.benign_reason: Single real-hardware benign IoT capture with official expert-labeled Zeek flows, fixed before scoring to make false-positive rate measurable.
allowed_after_freeze: one-shot inference with a model/scaler/threshold frozen without IoT-23
compute recall, FPR, precision, F1, PR-AUC/AUROC where defined, and per-label support
forbidden_after_freeze: select a threshold from IoT-23 labels
select model or hyperparameters from IoT-23 metrics
call controlled IoT-23 traffic production-enterprise traffic
